label: DAY 39
title: My AI channel's newest Short got 0 views in 5 hours. I'm not deleting it.

scenes.label: Day 38, first 4 hours 57 minutes
scenes.sub: views. Ranked 10 of my last 10 (YouTube Studio)

lines.text: Your new Short's out! How many views?
Five hours in. Last place out of my ten newest.
Okay, but the rest of the channel?
Eighteen views in two days. Forty-five videos.

scenes.text: Delete it and post it again?

lines.text: Just delete it and upload it again.
I almost would. Then I checked Day fifteen.
Day fifteen had one view after fifteen hours.
Two days later, it had ten.
So slow starts can still move?
That one did. It's one example, not proof.
Was it the new line at the end?
It's the first Short with it. One video can't tell me.

scenes.text: My bet: Day 38 hits 10+ views by Thursday
scenes.sub: Nov 26, three days after it aired. Graded on screen

lines.text: So I'm keeping it. My bet: ten views by Thursday.

scenes.text: Ever posted something that got zero?
scenes.sub: Did you keep it or delete it? Tell me in the comments
lines: Have you ever posted something that got zero? Did you keep it?
